title: OIDC callback uses bpm-default realm authority instead of tenant realm — signinRedirectCallback exchanges code with wrong Keycloak realm, causing redirect loop
category: logic error — singleton cache bypasses realm resolution at callback time
resolution: redirect_uri now embeds ?realm=<slug> via buildRedirectArgs() (web/src/auth/oidcRedirectArgs.ts), called from AuthProvider.tsx:44 and ProtectedRoute.tsx:17. OidcCallbackPage.tsx:45 resolves realm via resolveRealmFromUrl() with sessionStorage fallback before exchanging the code, matching fix_approach exactly.
verification: Batch re-triage 2026-08-10 (WF03-batch-GH280-301-triage-20260810): source-verified. Unit tests pass (TC-OIDC-F02-01, TC-OIDC-F06-01, etc. — same 5/5 run as ISS-0072). Minor note: a near-duplicate buildRedirectArgs also lives inline in AuthProvider.tsx:13-17 — harmless duplication, not a functional bug, not blocking closure.

diagnosis.symptom: After Alice logs in via the SwiftRoute Keycloak realm, Keycloak redirects to /auth/callback. A redirect loop starts. The app keeps cycling back to / and re-initiating Keycloak login.
diagnosis.root_cause_detail: OidcCallbackPage calls getOidcManager() (line 35), which returns a cached _resolvedManager if already set, or builds one via fetchTenantConfig(window.location.hostname). At /auth/callback the URL contains no ?realm= parameter. fetchTenantConfig calls resolveRealmFromUrl() which reads sessionStorage['bpm_realm_slug']. If this key is absent (sessionStorage was not populated during the login-initiation flow, or was cleared), resolveRealmFromUrl returns null and fetchTenantConfig falls back to ?host=hostname, which returns the bpm-default realm. getOidcManager() then creates a bpm-default UserManager and caches it. signinRedirectCallback() called on that UserManager attempts to exchange the swiftroute-issued auth code with the bpm-default token endpoint, which rejects it. The catch block calls window.location.replace('/'), reloading the app, which re-initiates login — with the same cached bpm-default manager — producing an infinite redirect loop.
diagnosis.secondary_factor: fetchTenantConfig() caches its result in module-level _cachedConfig. If the first call at callback time fetches bpm-default (due to missing sessionStorage entry), all subsequent calls in the same page load also return bpm-default. The singleton cache makes the error self-perpetuating within the session.
diagnosis.tertiary_factor: OidcManager.ts exports a synchronous oidcManager singleton (line 36) built from VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY defaults (bpm-default). If any code path consumes this sync export at module-load time and triggers getOidcManager() before sessionStorage is checked, _resolvedManager could be initialized to bpm-default before OidcCallbackPage's useEffect fires.

fix_approach: The redirect_uri supplied to signinRedirect() must include the realm slug as a query parameter (e.g. /auth/callback?realm=swiftroute). This ensures resolveRealmFromUrl() at callback time reads ?realm= from the actual URL, independently of sessionStorage state. OidcCallbackPage must also bypass the _resolvedManager singleton and create a fresh UserManager from the result of fetchTenantConfig() for the callback exchange, to avoid stale bpm-default cache poisoning the code exchange.
